RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may possess 2 ounces of marijuana, or 10 ounces at home.
RECREATIONAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massachusetts-law-about-recreational-marijuana.
RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Massachusetts?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: You may possess 2 oz. or have 10 oz. at home (MGL c. 94G, § 7)

RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may purchase up to 2 ounces of marijuana.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/mass-general-laws-c94g-ss-7.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for adults to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Massachusetts?
RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_section: possessing, using, purchasing, processing or manufacturing 2 ounces or less of marijuana or the equivalent amount of marijuana products as determined by the commission

RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may grow up to 6 plants at home, or 12 plants if more than one adult in the household grows.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massachusetts-law-about-recreational-marijuana.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for adults to grow cannabis in the state of Massachusetts?
RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_section: You can only grow up to 6 plants in your home If there's more than one person over 21 living in the home who wants to grow at home, the maximum number of plants that may be grown in a home is 12 plants

RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_quote: No person shall consume marijuana in a public place or smoke marijuana where smoking tobacco is prohibited.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/mass-general-laws-c94g-ss-13.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.question: Is it legal to consume cannabis in parks, on sidewalks, or similar outdoor public spaces in the state of Massachusetts?
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_section: No person shall consume marijuana in a public place or smoke marijuana where smoking tobacco is prohibited.

RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_quote: Public consumption is prohibited except in a designated area of a licensed marijuana establishment in a city or town that has voted to allow on-premises consumption. This host does not list an open public consumption venue.
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/mass-general-laws-c94g-ss-13.
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.question: Is it legal for public businesses such as cafes, bars, or conference centers to allow on-site cannabis consumption in the state of Massachusetts?
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_section: No person shall consume marijuana in a public place or smoke marijuana where smoking tobacco is prohibited.

MEDICAL.gov_quote: A registered qualifying patient or personal caregiver is not subject to arrest or prosecution for medical-use marijuana.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/mass-general-laws-c94i-ss-2.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Massachusetts?
MEDICAL.gov_section: A qualifying patient or a personal caregiver shall not be subject to arrest or prosecution, or civil penalty, for medical use marijuana

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Registered qualifying patients may purchase medical-use marijuana from a licensed medical marijuana establishment.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/mass-general-laws-c94i-ss-2.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Massachusetts?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: The commission shall operate a medical use of marijuana program, which shall permit a qualifying patient with a debilitating medical condition to obtain a written or electronic certification from a healthcare professional with whom the patient has a bona fide healthcare professional-patient relationship to purchase medical use marijuana from a medical marijuana establishment.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: A qualifying patient or their caregiver with a cultivation registration may grow plants sufficient for a 60-day supply of medical marijuana.
MEDICAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.mass.gov/info-details/mass-general-laws-c94i-ss-2.
MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of Massachusetts?
MEDICAL_GROW.gov_section: Such registration shall allow the qualifying patient or the qualifying patient's personal caregiver to cultivate a limited number of plants, sufficient to maintain a 60-day supply of marijuana, and shall require cultivation and storage only in an enclosed, locked area.

sourceNotes: This pass started from https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massachusetts-law-about-recreational-marijuana on 2026-09-08 and stayed on mass.gov. That page is the Trial Court Law Libraries recreational-marijuana guide. It answers adult possession of 2 ounces, or 10 ounces at home, and home cultivation of 6 plants, or 12 per household. It links to the Mass.gov texts of MGL c. 94G, § 7 and § 13 and to the medical-marijuana law page. Section 7 authorizes purchasing 2 ounces or less. Section 13 bans consumption in a public place, with an exception for a designated area of a marijuana establishment in a city or town that has voted to allow on-premises consumption. Chapter 65 of the Acts of 2026, signed April 19, 2026, authorized on-site consumption licenses, but no HTML page on this host lists an open public consumption venue. MGL c. 94I, § 2 on mass.gov answers medical possession, purchase at a medical marijuana establishment, and hardship cultivation registration. The stored malegislature.gov citations and the masscannabiscontrol.com medical pages were replaced because those hosts are not the requested source and this host already answers the questions. masscannabiscontrol.com remains the Cannabis Control Commission's own site, confirmed by a link from mass.gov/orgs/cannabis-control-commission, checked 2026-08-31; it was not cited on this pass. The earlier MEDICAL_STORE path on that host redirected to a PDF. Fetch with browser headers returns 200 and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
